# Remepy Raises $36M Series A for Hybrid Drug Platform

Remepy raised $36M Series A led by O.G. Venture Partners and M Ventures for its Hybrid Drugs combining pharmaceuticals with AI digital protocols. The approach targets Parkinson's and oncology.

Emel Kavaloglu

Aug 12, 2026

Remepy ([remepy.com](https://remepy.com)), a New York-based company developing Hybrid Drugs that pair traditional pharmaceuticals with AI-driven digital protocols into a single regulated prescription, has raised $36 million in Series A funding led by O.G. Venture Partners and M Ventures.
The approach combines the biological mechanism of a drug with personalized digital interventions measured and adapted by AI. The capital will advance Phase III trials of Hybridopa for Parkinson's disease and expand pharmaceutical partnerships.

## PDURS Pathway Enables Drug-Software Combinations

The timing comes amid growing interest in drug-digital combinations: Click Therapeutics raised [$50M Series D](https://www.clicktherapeutics.com) from Boehringer Ingelheim in 2026, while Akili Interactive has raised over $160M. Remepy's approach — owning the full drug pipeline end-to-end — addresses the reimbursement challenges that led to Pear Therapeutics' bankruptcy.

## Phase IIa Data Shows Doubled Drug Effect

Parkinson's patients treated with Hybridopa showed a 9.7-point improvement on the MDS-UPDRS scale versus 1.95 for placebo in a double-blind Phase IIa trial, with 90% achieving clinically meaningful response.
Current levodopa treatments see motor fluctuations in over 50% of patients within five years. Standalone digital therapeutics have struggled with reimbursement, as seen with Pear Therapeutics' 2023 bankruptcy.

## Hybrid Model Integrates Drug and App

Remepy pairs Levodopa with DopApp, an AI-driven protocol targeting motor, cognitive, speech, and mental function. Unlike Click Therapeutics' licensing model or Akili's standalone games, Remepy owns the drug end-to-end and pursues FDA's PDURS framework for inclusion on drug labels. This creates a new category of Hybrid Drugs regulated and reimbursed like pharmaceuticals.

> 

"The app essentially added as much benefit as the molecule itself." — Dr. Michal Tsur

## Strategic Investors Signal Pharma Validation

M Ventures, Merck KGaA's corporate venture arm, led the round alongside O.G. Venture Partners.

# Remepy Raises $36 Million Series A to Expand Its Hybrid Drug™ Pipeline Through Pharmaceutical Partnerships and Advance Phase III of Hybridopa™ for Parkinson's Disease

August 12, 2026

_Funding brings total capital raised to $62 million as the Company expands pharmaceutical co-development partnerships and accelerates the Hybrid Drug category_

**NEW YORK, NY August 12, 2026** – Remepy ( [www.remepy.com](http://www.remepy.com) ), the pioneer of Hybrid Drugs, today announced the closing of a $36 million Series A financing round led by O.G. Venture Partners and M Ventures, the corporate strategic venture arm of Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany, with participation of existing and new investors including NFX, Vine Ventures, Qumra Capital, TechAviv, 97212 Ventures, Fresh Fund, PsyMed Ventures, Tadmor Group, Key1 Capital, and IT-Farm Corp.

...

By bringing together biotechnology, AI, and digital health, Remepy is redefining how medicines are developed and delivered. With compelling clinical data, growing regulatory momentum, and strong validation from leading pharmaceutical partners, we believe Hybrid Drugs have the potential to transform patient care - and we're proud to support Remepy in its next phase of growth.”

**Dr. Eyal Ben Ami, Scientific Lead at M Ventures,** "Remepy's pioneering Hybrid Drugs approach reflects the growing importance and applicability of integrating AI into the delivery of health and physical medicines. Our investment from M Ventures is intended to further enable the company, underscoring our belief that this new class of medicine - that combines innovative therapeutics with AI-driven, patient-centered care - has the potential to redefine medicine. We look forward to advancing it across multiple drug classes and disease areas.”

...

Remepy is turning drugs into intelligent, software-enabled, adaptive treatment platforms. For additional information, please visit: <https://www.remepy.com/>

## **About O.G. Venture Partners** ‍

O.G. Venture Partners (OGVP) is a global, single-LP venture capital fund founded in 2017 and backed by Eyal Ofer’s Ofer Global, and focused primarily on early growth-stage investments, typically in Series B and C rounds. OGVP manages over $1.5 billion in assets under management (AUM). Its active portfolio includes companies such as Lendbuzz, Coralogix, Via, Neko Health, Connecteam, Peregrine, Superplay, and Buildots, among others.

## About M Ventures

M Ventures is the strategic, corporate venture capital arm of Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany. From its headquarters in the Netherlands and offices in Germany, USA and Israel, M Ventures invests globally in transformational ideas driven by innovative entrepreneurs.
